verdict.rationale: Pinecone's own docs mention an official Pinecone SDK, used for example to create backups, and its llms.txt says the official docs cover SDKs. That confirms first-party SDKs exist, but nothing names the languages they ship in. missing for 10: evidence of official Python, TypeScript, Go and Java SDKs, SDK reference documentation per language, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build against official SDKs in the major languages (Python, TypeScript, Go, Java)
